svg.title: Kedhar, tokenized
svg.desc: An ASCII portrait of Kedhar decodes from scrambled characters while a scan line passes over it. Beside it the name KEDHAR draws itself and his bio appears as tokenizer chips: AI engineer & full-stack dev. #1 on 21st.dev. builds agents that ship.
svg.text: 17 TOKENS · AI ENGINEER & FULL-STACK DEVELOPER · MADANAPALLI, IN
